pkg/server/desthost_backend_manager.go (1)
`86-86`: _⚡ Quick win_ **Remove unused variable `firstDrainingBackend`.** The variable `firstDrainingBackend` is assigned but its value is never used—only its nil-ness is checked on line 98. However, this check is redundant: given that `len(bes) > 0` (guaranteed by line 81) and the read lock prevents concurrent modification, the loop will always examine at least one backend, making `firstDrainingBackend` non-nil when we reach line 98. The fallback on line 100 picks a random draining backend rather than returning `firstDrainingBackend`, so the variable serves no purpose.
♻️ Simplify by removing the unused variable ```diff klog.V(5).InfoS("Get the backend through the DestHostBackendManager", "destHost", destHost) // Randomly select from non-draining backends first startIdx := dibm.random.Intn(len(bes)) - var firstDrainingBackend *Backend for i := 0; i < len(bes); i++ { idx := (startIdx + i) % len(bes) if !bes[idx].IsDraining() { return bes[idx], nil } - if firstDrainingBackend == nil { - firstDrainingBackend = bes[idx] - } } // All backends for this destination are draining, fall back to a random draining one - if firstDrainingBackend != nil { - klog.V(3).InfoS("All backends for destination host are draining, using one as fallback", "destHost", destHost) - return bes[dibm.random.Intn(len(bes))], nil - } + klog.V(3).InfoS("All backends for destination host are draining, using one as fallback", "destHost", destHost) + return bes[dibm.random.Intn(len(bes))], nil } ```
